title: Exceptional
body: A very good app for tracking your habits. But would recommend to implement iOS 26 app UI for better integration for the os. Nonetheless, an exceptional app. 5 stars!!
author: sgkanefdg

title: Awesome!
body:
I really love your app, it help me to track my habit and improve that, UI is really great! 

I have one feature request, I think it will better if we can show count streak in the widget on mobile Home Screen, this can motivate everyone to keep the streak to continue and growth. Please consider this and I’m looking forward to see it. Thanks in advance 😆
author: Neungszad

body: Great app, exactly what I was looking for (simple & easy to use)
